Updates `cn` from 0.5.0 to 0.5.2
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/releases">cn's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>cn@0.5.2</h2>
<h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://redirect.github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/pull/162">#162</a> <a href="https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/commit/b8c5a1b23d606790ebae8343268a16503fd8a1e6"><code>b8c5a1b</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/nonhana"><code>@​nonhana</code></a>! - Export <code>CnFunction</code>, <code>Engine</code>, and <code>ClassNameValue</code> from <code>cn/config</code>, and those plus <code>ClassValue</code> from <code>cn/engine</code>. Exporting an inferred <code>createCn()</code> result (<code>export const cn = createCn({ ... })</code>) no longer fails with TS2742 or TS2883 in projects that emit declarations.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://redirect.github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/pull/167">#167</a> <a href="https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/commit/6ebb4ce6284826736f0cc3af7aac7b9fbe54b161"><code>6ebb4ce</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/RaphaelFakhri"><code>@​RaphaelFakhri</code></a>! - <code>cn build</code> keeps numeric spacing such as <code>p-4</code> when a stylesheet declares <code>--spacing</code> after a <code>--*: initial</code> or <code>--spacing-*: initial</code> reset, and keeps <code>p-px</code> through the reset, as Tailwind does.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://redirect.github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/pull/160">#160</a> <a href="https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/commit/a805c685b456b759125b521a2530d3038cc60c74"><code>a805c68</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/mehimanshupatil"><code>@​mehimanshupatil</code></a>! - <code>createCn</code>, <code>createTwMerge</code>, and <code>extendTailwindMerge</code> from <code>cn/config</code> accept optional type arguments for custom class-group and theme ids, like tailwind-merge's <code>extendTailwindMerge&lt;ClassGroupIds, ThemeGroupIds&gt;</code>. With them, unknown group keys and conflict ids are type errors. Without them, any id is still accepted.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>cn@0.5.1</h2>
<h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://redirect.github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/pull/165">#165</a> <a href="https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/commit/5e65675b0e492972b68961e6abd6ad27cf462bef"><code>5e65675</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/shadcn"><code>@​shadcn</code></a>! - Group the legacy <code>bg-gradient-to-*</code> utilities as <code>bg-color</code>, the same as tailwind-merge. <code>cn(&quot;bg-background&quot;, &quot;bg-gradient-to-r&quot;)</code> now returns <code>bg-gradient-to-r</code>, and <code>bg-gradient-to-r</code> no longer replaces <code>bg-linear-to-r</code> or an arbitrary <code>bg-[...]</code> image.</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
</details>
<details>
<summary>Changelog</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn/blob/main/packages/cn/CHANGELOG.md">cn's changelog</a>.</em></p>

Updates `@tailwindcss/vite` from 4.3.3 to 4.3.5
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases">@​tailwindcss/vite's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>v4.3.5</h2>
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Canonicalization: improve performance in projects with many functional variant values (e.g. a <code>matchVariant</code> plugin with thousands of values) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20663">#20663</a>)</li>
<li>Don't crash or create a fallback with the wrong color for a <code>color-mix(…)</code> without a color interpolation method (e.g. <code>color-mix(var(--color-red-500))</code> or <code>color-mix(currentcolor 50%, transparent)</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20658">#20658</a>, <a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20666">#20666</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi</code> loads instead of hanging forever (e.g. with <code>NAPI_RS_FORCE_WASI=error</code> or in WebContainers) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20667">#20667</a>)</li>
<li>Remove <code>as: '*.css'</code> from the <code>@tailwindcss/turbopack</code> setup in its README, because it breaks CSS modules (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20660">#20660</a>)</li>
<li>Ignore <code>&lt;!--</code> and <code>--&gt;</code> between top-level rules in CSS instead of throwing or swallowing the next rule (e.g. <code>a { color: red } --&gt; b { color: blue }</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20665">#20665</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi</code> detects changed and new source files after the first scan (e.g. in WebContainers) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20487">#20487</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent type errors with <code>skipLibCheck: false</code> caused by imports of unshipped modules in the <code>@tailwindcss/node</code> type declarations (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20632">#20632</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h2>v4.3.4</h2>
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>@tailwindcss/turbopack</code>, a Turbopack loader for using Tailwind CSS with Next.js (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20367">#20367</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure watch mode detects changes to symlinked <code>@source</code> files whose real paths aren't otherwise scanned (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20356">#20356</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure variants using <code>@scope</code> wrap generated utilities instead of nesting inside them (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20369">#20369</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure nested <code>@scope</code> rules preserve their scoping semantics when flattened (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20369">#20369</a>)</li>
<li>Preserve declarations directly inside <code>@scope</code> by wrapping them in <code>:where(:scope)</code> (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20369">#20369</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure generated utilities include a space in empty <code>var()</code> fallbacks (e.g. <code>var(--tw-blur,)</code> → <code>var(--tw-blur, )</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20373">#20373</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: convert arbitrary breakpoint and container query variants to named equivalents (e.g. <code>max-[64rem]:flex</code> → <code>max-lg:flex</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20380">#20380</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> from crashing on every edit under Vite's experimental <code>bundledDev</code> mode (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20379">#20379</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/oxide</code> falls back to WASM on platforms without native bindings (<code>@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi</code> now installs on all platforms, but only loads when no native binding is available) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20383">#20383</a>)</li>
<li>Extract class candidates from Ruby <code>%w</code> and <code>%W</code> literals using angle brackets or custom delimiters (e.g. <code>%w&lt;flex&gt;</code>, <code>%w|flex|</code>), including in Slim and Haml templates (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20387">#20387</a>)</li>
<li>Preserve whitespace in <code>--default(…)</code> values in functional <code>@utility</code> definitions (e.g. <code>--default(box alphabetic)</code> no longer becomes <code>boxalphabetic</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20392">#20392</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure automatic source detection respects negation-based <code>.gitignore</code> files (e.g. <code>/*</code> followed by <code>!/…</code> patterns) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20397">#20397</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure root <code>theme('…')</code> namespace lookups in JavaScript plugins and config files return the full namespace object instead of the value of its <code>DEFAULT</code> key (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20399">#20399</a>)</li>
<li>Skip ignored directories when generating watch globs instead of walking their contents on every rebuild (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20408">#20408</a>)</li>
<li>Drop invalid UTF-8 candidates during class detection (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20389">#20389</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> from forcing full-page reloads for scanned files that Vite does not handle as modules (e.g. <code>.php</code> files) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20414">#20414</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: don't merge utilities that reference different theme variables set to CSS-wide keywords like <code>unset</code> (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20417">#20417</a>)</li>
<li>Don't generate utilities when a modifier is used that would otherwise be silently ignored (e.g. <code>rounded-sm/[5]</code>, <code>shadow-sm/foo</code>, <code>stroke-2/50</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20419">#20419</a>)</li>
<li>Preserve <code>and</code>, <code>or</code>, and <code>not</code> inside selectors in <code>supports-[…]</code> variants (e.g. <code>supports-[selector(a:not(.foo))]:flex</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20420">#20420</a>)</li>
<li>Don't warn about Angular's <code>::ng-deep</code> and <code>:host-context()</code> when optimizing CSS (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20434">#20434</a>)</li>
<li>Don't generate CSS for candidates containing an empty additional modifier (e.g. <code>bg-red-500/50/</code> and <code>group-hover/foo//bar:flex</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20466">#20466</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>min-*</code>, <code>max-*</code>, and container query variants with decimal values are sorted numerically (e.g. <code>min-[40.25rem]</code> before <code>min-[40.5rem]</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20512">#20512</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure CSS comments ending with <code>\*/</code> are closed correctly instead of swallowing the CSS that follows (e.g. <code>/* C:\temp\*/</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20508">#20508</a>)</li>
<li>Improve style invalidation performance of <code>group-*</code> and <code>peer-*</code> variants (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20513">#20513</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure cached compilers release their <code>loadModule</code> and <code>loadStylesheet</code> callbacks after compilation (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20531">#20531</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: preserve <code>&amp;</code> when moving a pseudo-element into <code>*</code> or <code>**</code> (e.g. <code>[&amp;_::before]:flex</code> → <code>**:[&amp;::before]:flex</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20550">#20550</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure the <code>Set.prototype.intersection</code> polyfill in <code>canonicalizeCandidates(…)</code> returns the intersection instead of the first set on Node.js &lt; 22 (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20562">#20562</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: ensure inline <code>theme(…)</code> alphas with more than 2 decimals migrate to a percentage modifier with the same opacity (e.g. <code>theme(colors.red.500/.12345)</code> → <code>text-red-500/[12.345%]</code>, not <code>text-red-500/[12.345]</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20563">#20563</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: preserve inline <code>theme(…)</code> alphas as an arbitrary percentage when a custom <code>--opacity-*</code> theme value would change the opacity (e.g. <code>theme(colors.red.500/50%)</code> → <code>text-red-500/[50%]</code> with <code>--opacity-50: 10%</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20563">#20563</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure the <code>@property</code> fallback isn't applied in Safari versions that no longer support <code>margin-trim: inline</code> (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20569">#20569</a>)</li>
<li>Treat viewport units like <code>dvmin</code> and <code>svi</code> and font-relative units like <code>cap</code> and <code>rex</code> as lengths in arbitrary values (e.g. <code>text-[10dvmin]</code> generates <code>font-size</code> instead of <code>color</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20516">#20516</a>)</li>
<li>Write plugin logs to stderr in <code>tailwindcss canonicalize</code> so they don't end up in the results on stdout (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20561">#20561</a>)</li>
<li>Extract class shorthands on later lines when Pug text, comments, or quoted attribute values contain unbalanced brackets, or a quote that doesn't start a string (e.g. <code>input(pattern=/&quot;/.source)</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20547">#20547</a>, <a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20572">#20572</a>)</li>
</ul>

<p><em>Sourced from <a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md">@​tailwindcss/vite's changelog</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>[4.3.5] - 2026-11-06</h2>
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Canonicalization: improve performance in projects with many functional variant values (e.g. a <code>matchVariant</code> plugin with thousands of values) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20663">#20663</a>)</li>
<li>Don't crash or create a fallback with the wrong color for a <code>color-mix(…)</code> without a color interpolation method (e.g. <code>color-mix(var(--color-red-500))</code> or <code>color-mix(currentcolor 50%, transparent)</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20658">#20658</a>, <a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20666">#20666</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi</code> loads instead of hanging forever (e.g. with <code>NAPI_RS_FORCE_WASI=error</code> or in WebContainers) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20667">#20667</a>)</li>
<li>Remove <code>as: '*.css'</code> from the <code>@tailwindcss/turbopack</code> setup in its README, because it breaks CSS modules (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20660">#20660</a>)</li>
<li>Ignore <code>&lt;!--</code> and <code>--&gt;</code> between top-level rules in CSS instead of throwing or swallowing the next rule (e.g. <code>a { color: red } --&gt; b { color: blue }</code>) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20665">#20665</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi</code> detects changed and new source files after the first scan (e.g. in WebContainers) (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20487">#20487</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent type errors with <code>skipLibCheck: false</code> caused by imports of unshipped modules in the <code>@tailwindcss/node</code> type declarations (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20632">#20632</a>)</li>

Updates `@vitejs/plugin-react` from 6.1.2 to 6.3.0
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/releases">@​vitejs/plugin-react's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>plugin-react@6.3.0</h2>
<h3>Make <code>reactCompilerPreset</code> work with <code>@rolldown/plugin-babel</code>'s <code>parallel</code> option (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/pull/1549">#1549</a>)</h3>
<p><code>reactCompilerPreset</code> now refers to its Babel preset by module path instead of by function, so it can be sent to worker threads.</p>
<h2>plugin-react@6.2.1</h2>
<h3>Fix <code>refreshInclude</code> and <code>refreshExclude</code> options not working (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/pull/1543">#1543</a>)</h3>
<p>Fix mistake from <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/tree/HEAD/packages/plugin-react/issues/1516">#1516</a></p>
<h2>plugin-react@6.2.0</h2>
<h3>Add <code>refreshInclude</code> and <code>refreshExclude</code> options (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/pull/1516">#1516</a>)</h3>
<p>Add <code>refreshInclude</code> and <code>refreshExclude</code> options to skip fast refresh for certain files that won't run in the browser.</p>
<h3>Expand <code>oxc-transform-react</code> peer dependency range (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/pull/1540">#1540</a>)</h3>
<p>The peer dependency version range for <code>oxc-transform-react</code> was expanded from <code>^0.152.0</code> to <code>&gt;=0.152.0 &lt;0.157.0</code>.</p>
<h3>Expand <code>@rolldown/plugin-babel</code> peer dependency range (<a href="https://redirect.github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/pull/1541">#1541</a>)</h3>
<p>The peer dependency version range for <code>@rolldown/plugin-babel</code> was expanded from <code>^0.1.7 || ^0.2.0</code> to <code>^0.1.7 || ^0.2.0 || ^0.3.0</code>.</p>
